name: customer-reactivation-audit
description: Assess appropriate past-customer eligibility and design a useful reactivation plan, separating opt-outs, uncertain relevance and overlapping quote or renewal pools.

interface.longDescription: Assess appropriate past-customer eligibility and design a useful reactivation plan, separating opt-outs, uncertain relevance and overlapping quote or renewal pools. For home service owners and teams. Delivers editable company-branded Markdown plus styled HTML, evidence labels and an internally usable implementation blueprint. Matches verified website branding or owner-selected trade palettes. Qualitative findings are valid when data is missing. Conditional financial opportunity is not guaranteed. Plans and drafts only; no live integrations, automatic outreach, calendar changes or monitoring. AI Growth Studio is the developer; optional implementation support is separate from the audit.
defaultPrompt: Assess which past customers are suitable to reconnect with and draft a practical plan.
